items.title: Week 2 Announcements
items.text:
Today, Friday, September 4:

  *   The dedicated CSCI 127 lab is open 11:30-4pm (shorter hours on Fridays).
  *   Need some help getting started?  The lab is staffed with amazing peer instructors who will guide you through the first lab and homework.
  *   Come in today and earn an extra 5% on your written quiz and oral code review for completing them early.
  *   Appointments available via Navigate or drop in for the next available slot.
  *   We use Gradescope for submitting and grading coursework.  An invitation was sent to your CUNY account (e.g. first.last##@login.cuny.edu).  If you didn't get a Gradescope invitation, fill out the Request for Gradescope Account.<https://brightspace.cuny.edu/d2l/common/dialogs/quickLink/quickLink.d2l?ou=1315489&type=survey&rCode=553F80D6-3EB2-4A0C-B321-7D8FDFC0E4FA-9238746>

Monday, September 7:

  *   The college is closed due to the Labor Day holiday.
  *   You can still access the homework and submit via Gradescope, but no tutoring is available since the college is closed.

items.text: Optional focused review Tuesday 9:30–10:00 am in 118 HN before lecture. Homework 1, Quiz 1 and Code Review 1 are due by 5:00 pm on Tuesday, September 8.

items.text: 1001E HN lab hours: Monday–Thursday 11:30 am–5:15 pm, Friday 11:30 am–4:00 pm, when classes meet. Lecture slides are posted on Brightspace on Tuesdays at 9 am.
